title: Amazingly Acidic Spanish Orange Ensaimada
description: A sour and juicy Andalusian dish featuring molasses, perfect for a festive occasion, this macrobiotic-friendly ensaimada is a unique twist on traditional Spanish cuisine.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the orange juice, molasses, olive oil, and sea salt.
Add the orange zest and lemon juice to the bowl and stir to combine.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the flour and yeast.
Slowly add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover it with a damp cloth, and let it rise in a warm place for 1 hour.
Punch down the dough and shape it into an ensaimada.
Place the ensaimada on a baking sheet and bake for 25 minutes.
Remove the ensaimada from the oven and let it cool on a wire rack.
